annotation.title_clean: Report 2019 Appendix 1: Practical Reference for AI Utilization (AI Utilization Guidelines)
annotation.title_en: Report 2019 Appendix 1: Practical Reference for AI Utilization (AI Utilization Guidelines)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The Conference toward AI Network Society (Japan, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's non-binding AI Utilization Guidelines set ten principles (proper utilization, data quality, collaboration, safety, security, privacy, dignity and autonomy, fairness, transparency, accountability) with commentary for AI service providers, business users, data providers and consumers. Only passing embodied provisions: harm through actuators and pet robots.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten voluntary AI Utilization Principles with stakeholder-specific commentary, as non-binding soft law
Safety principle: avoid harming life, body or property through actuators or other devices
Human intervention and clarified responsibility when systems shift to manual operation
Logging, explainability and published AI usage policies for transparency and accountability
Consistent with OECD AI Principles and Japan's Social Principles of Human-Centric AI
